title: Fixed-Fee Billing Structure of Professional Services Projects
content:
Under Professional Services Projects, a fixed-fee engagement is billed by its deposit, by one invoice per milestone and by a final invoice.

## Clauses

1. **Milestone invoices.** The former clause under which, when a milestone was recorded complete, its invoice was the class milestone share at that milestone's position times the contract value at that moment, rounded half up to the cent, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for milestone invoices.
2. **When a milestone may be invoiced.** A milestone may be invoiced only while the engagement status is in progress, on hold or pending acceptance. The status is read from the system record of the engagement before the invoice is posted.
3. **Final invoice.** On acceptance the final invoice bills the contract value minus everything already billed by the deposit and milestone invoices, rounded half up to the cent, so that a fixed fee is billed exactly once in total. The holdback is the class holdback percentage of the contract value.
4. **Time-and-materials engagements.** A time-and-materials engagement has no milestone or final invoices; it is billed only by its deposit and its monthly time-and-materials invoices, and its deposit is applied against its last time-and-materials invoices.
5. **Time on a fixed-fee engagement.** Time logged on a fixed-fee engagement is settled as internal fixed-fee time and is never billed.

The class figures this clause names (the deposit percentage, the milestone shares and the holdback percentage) are those of the billing schedule of each engagement class, from Assessment Engagement to Strategic Program.

## Status table for milestone invoicing

| Engagement status | Milestone may be invoiced |
|---|---|
| in progress | yes |
| on hold | yes |
| pending acceptance | yes |
| any other status | no |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A fixed-fee engagement has a contract value of 100000.00. Its deposit and milestone invoices have billed 80000.00 in total. On acceptance the final invoice bills 100000.00 less 80000.00, that is 20000.00, and the engagement has then been billed 100000.00 in total, exactly once.

superseded_clauses: When a milestone is recorded complete, its invoice is milestone_pcts at that milestone's position times contract_value_usd at that moment, rounded half up to the cent.
